parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of records in one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous call.

parameters.name: parentConnectionId
parameters.description: Filter by the connection that carried the invitation which produced this one

parameters.name: did
parameters.description: Filter by my DID for this connection

parameters.name: theirDid
parameters.description: Filter by the DID of the peer

parameters.name: didcommVersion
parameters.description: Filter by negotiated DIDComm version. `v1` selects the connections established through a handshake protocol, which the store leaves without an explicit version.
